slides.title: Cleaning tools that remove the step my ADHD brain always skips
Soap-dispensing dish brush
slides.body: No separate soap step. Grab, scrub, rinse. Fewer steps means the dish gets washed now, not later.

slides.title: A spray mop
slides.body: No bucket to fill, carry and dump. The bucket was the reason we never mopped.

slides.title: Cordless stick vacuum on a wall mount
slides.body: Visible and charged, right in the hallway. No dragging the big vacuum out of the closet.

slides.title: A cleaning caddy per floor
slides.body: Spray, cloths, gloves in one handle. Grab it and go. No gathering supplies first.

slides.title: Microfiber cloths in bulk
slides.body: Use one, toss it in the wash. No wringing out a sad sponge. A cloth is always ready.

slides.title: I don't hate cleaning. I hate the 4 steps before cleaning.
